title: Convoy: Important Systems
summary: Read the Convoy signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Route definitions and incident profiles describe what can happen on the way. Treat incidents as planning data, not surprise punishment.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch route length, cargo priority, incident risk, staging supplies, vehicle or mount readiness, and whether the return path is still safer than pushing forward.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A Convoy system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
